Ordination plot with ellipses and PERMANOVA

Source: R/mp_ordination.R
mp_ordination.Rd

Computes an ordination from a phyloseq::phyloseq object and renders a publication-ready scatter plot. Distance-based methods (PCoA, NMDS, dbRDA) accept any phyloseq::distance() metric; PCA operates on centred log-ratio (Aitchison) coordinates; RDA and CCA support constrained ordination against metadata. Group ellipses and a PERMANOVA result are added automatically.

Usage

mp_ordination(
  object,
  method = c("PCoA", "NMDS", "PCA", "RDA", "CCA", "dbRDA"),
  distance = "bray",
  group.by = NULL,
  shape.by = NULL,
  ellipse = TRUE,
  ellipse.type = c("norm", "t", "euclid"),
  ellipse.level = 0.95,
  permanova = TRUE,
  permutations = 999,
  constraints = NULL,
  add.vectors = FALSE,
  envfit = NULL,
  axes = c(1, 2),
  label.samples = FALSE,
  point.size = 2.5,
  point.alpha = 0.85,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

method

One of "PCoA", "NMDS", "PCA", "RDA", "CCA", "dbRDA".

distance

Distance metric for distance-based methods. Any value accepted by phyloseq::distance() (e.g. "bray", "jaccard", "unifrac", "wunifrac", "canberra") plus "aitchison".

group.by

Metadata column mapped to point colour (and used for ellipses and PERMANOVA).

shape.by

Optional metadata column mapped to point shape.

ellipse

Draw group ellipses.

ellipse.type

Ellipse type passed to ggplot2::stat_ellipse().

ellipse.level

Confidence level for ellipses.

permanova

Run vegan::adonis2() and append the result to the caption (distance-based methods only).

permutations

Number of PERMANOVA permutations.

constraints

For "RDA", "CCA" and "dbRDA", a character vector of metadata columns to constrain the ordination on.

add.vectors

Overlay constraint/biplot arrows (constrained methods).

envfit

Optional character vector of (numeric) metadata columns to fit onto the ordination as vectors via vegan::envfit(). Significant vectors are overlaid as arrows and summarised in the caption.

axes

Length-2 integer vector of axes to plot.

label.samples

Label individual sample points (via ggrepel).

point.size

Point size.

point.alpha

Point opacity.

palette

Palette name, colour vector, or NULL. See mp_palette().

theme

A ggplot2 theme; defaults to the active theme (see mp_set_defaults(), otherwise mp_theme_publication()).

...

Additional arguments passed to the point geom (ggplot2::geom_point()).

plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption

Optional labels; the caption is auto-generated when NULL.

font.size

Base font size.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

return.data

If TRUE, return the underlying data frame of sample scores and metadata (with the ordination object and any PERMANOVA/envfit results attached as attributes) instead of a plot.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object, a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE, or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq")
mp_ordination(GlobalPatterns, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray",
              group.by = "SampleType")
} # }
